mapper.select:
SELECT GROUPCD, GROUPNAME, COMCD, COMNAME, BANPUMPER, NICKNAME, BANPUMPROC, CHK, (IF JEGOEDIT = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' ENDIF) JEGOEDIT FROM COMPANY_TB WHERE 1 = 1 AND GROUPCD = #{USER.GROUPCD}
AND COMNAME LIKE '%' + #{frmCUSTNAME} + '%'
AND CHK = 'Y'
AND CHK = 'N'
ORDER BY GROUPCD ASC,COMCD ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMPANY_TB ( GROUPCD ,GROUPNAME ,COMCD ,COMNAME ,NICKNAME ,JEGOEDIT ,PRDATETIME ,PRUSER ,CHK ) SELECT #{USER.GROUPCD} ,#{USER.GROUPNAME} ,#{COMCD} ,#{COMNAME} ,(IF #{NICKNAME}= '' THEN #{COMNAME} ELSE #{NICKNAME} ENDIF) ,ISNULL(#{JEGOEDIT},'Y') ,#{USER.USERID} ,DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'YYYYMMDDHHNNSS') ,'Y' FROM DUMMY WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COMPANY_TB C WHERE C.COMCD = #{COMCD})
